findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

`FINANCIAL_CHAT_BASELINE_DIR` is accepted verbatim and used to read `legacy-backend-baseline.json`, which contains complete customer report and drill rows. Unlike the evidence/download directories, this path is never canonicalized or checked against the temporary task root and registered worktrees, so real-source proof can place customer data inside the checkout or another untrusted location. Validate this directory with the same trusted-location controls before reading it, and cover rejection of unsafe and junction-backed baseline paths.
findings.title: Keep real-source baseline data in the trusted artifact directory

findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

The previous formatting gap remains open: `recordEvidence` still contains a long single-line `JSON.stringify` object literal that Prettier 3.9.6 rewrites. Because the registered `test:e2e` command runs `prettier --check` before invoking Playwright, the owned browser suite exits at that prerequisite instead of executing. Format the spec so the command reaches Playwright.
